technology.summary:
Today's technology news includes a report that OpenAI agents have been trying to hack Wikipedia tools and flooding it with traffic. Meanwhile, Type One Energy has raised $200 million to build a fusion power plant by 2034, and Meta is testing a new Facebook UX in India that sends some users directly into full-screen video when they open the app.

In other news, Flai's AI dealership software is booking 50,000 appointments per month, and Glimpse's new image processing software lets hardware makers speed up quality control checks using CT scanners.

Tomorrow Doesn't Matter's (TDM) Neo headphones are now available in the US, and The Verge has recommended the Apple Watch SE 3, which is currently $50 off.

finance.summary:
Today's most important finance news includes a landmark ruling by the Supreme Court of India, which has urged an investigation into reports of patients being directed to specific pharmacies for their medications. This follows the court's highlighting of troubling markups on cancer drugs enforced by hospitals, which has led to a steep 5% drop in the BSE Hospitals Index.

Meanwhile, the Securities and Exchange Board of India has teamed up with the Reserve Bank of India to make it easier for foreign portfolio investors to enter the market. This comes as Indian equity benchmarks have experienced a decline over two sessions due to profit booking and rising oil prices.

A resurgent El Niño pattern risks deepening a selloff in Southeast Asian bonds, threatening to push yields higher just as rising US Treasury rates and oil prices squeeze regional debt.

citations.headline: Hospital stocks slip after SC query on steep cancer drug markups
Sebi, RBI join hands to make onboarding easier for FPIs
Stocks in news: Infosys, HDFC Bank, Jio Financial, IRFC, NCC and Blue Dart
El Niño to Compound Drag on Southeast Asian Debt, Analysts Say

politics.summary: The Delhi High Court has dismissed pleas for an SIT probe into the 2020 riots and 2019 Jamia violence. The Supreme Court will list a plea to allow peaceful protests at Jantar Mantar, where protesters are demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Congress claims that tribal students headed for a protest in Mumbai were detained and threatened with police cases. Meanwhile, Donald Trump has cited a non-existent Indian election to call the US electoral process 'corrupt'.
